subject: UNACCEPTABLE OUTAGE! Entire workspace board disappeared during investor demo!
draft_reply:
Based on the context gathered, here is the triage summary and draft reply.

**Triage Summary:**
- **Category:** Bug
- **Urgency:** High
- **Customer:** CUST-113, Team plan (Priority support SLA: <4h), signed up 2025-03-14, 5 prior tickets
- **Issue:** Entire "Product Launch" board returned 404 NOT FOUND during a live investor demo
- **Key facts from docs:** Team plan includes Priority support (<4h response), SAML SSO & Audit Logs, and Full Workspace Backup capability. A 404 on a board can indicate a sync/availability issue or (less likely) accidental deletion — the latter has a 30-day recovery grace period.

---

**Draft Reply:**

Subject: Re: TKT-013 — Board 404 During Investor Demo — Escalated to Engineering

Hi [Customer Name],

First and foremost — I am truly sorry. What you experienced during your Series A investor presentation is not acceptable, and I completely understand how frustrating and embarrassing it was to have your Product Launch board go blank in front of your investors. That is not the experience we want any customer to have, and I want to make this right.

I have escalated this ticket to **High priority** and routed it directly to our Engineering team for immediate investigation. As a Team-plan customer, you are covered by our **Priority Support SLA (<4 hour response)**, and this incident is being treated accordingly.

**What we are doing right now:**
1. Engineering is pulling the access logs and availability records for your workspace to determine the root cause of the 404 error (whether it was a transient availability/sync issue or something else).
2. We are verifying that your "Product Launch" board and all its data (cards, comments, attachments) are intact and accessible.
3. Once we have a root-cause analysis, I will follow up with a written explanation and, if applicable, a service credit in line with our SLA terms.

**In the meantime, to protect your data:**
- If you are the Workspace Owner, you can request a **Full Workspace Archive** at any time via **Workspace Settings → Data Management → Request Full Workspace Archive**. The export link is delivered to your email within 30 minutes and remains active for 7 days.
- If the board was accidentally deleted (rather than an availability error), please note that FlowBoard offers a **30-day recovery grace period** — our team can restore the board from backup if you contact us within that window.

**Regarding your request for a VP-level explanation:** I have flagged this incident for leadership visibility. While I cannot guarantee a direct call from the VP of Engineering, I will ensure the incident report and root-cause summary are reviewed at that level, and I will share the findings with you in writing as soon as they are available.

I understand you mentioned canceling your Team contract and pursuing legal remedies. I want to be transparent: I take that seriously, and I want to give us the opportunity to demonstrate that we can resolve this properly. That said, if after reviewing the root-cause analysis and any remediation you feel the relationship cannot continue, we will honor your request to cancel and process any applicable service credits or refunds per our policy.

I will follow up within the next 4 hours with initial findings. In the interim, if you need anything else — a direct line, a status update, or help preparing a backup for future demos — please reply to this ticket and I will prioritize it.

Again, I am sorry for the disruption during such an important moment for your company. We will make this right.

Best regards,
[Agent Name]
FlowBoard Support — Priority Tier

---

*Internal note: Escalate to Engineering on-call immediately. Tag as P1 incident. Verify board integrity and pull access/availability logs for CUST-113 workspace. Loop in VP Eng for review. Prepare service-credit assessment per Team SLA.*
